revisionNotes: Reference condition is the fixed landscape-pressure screen least-disturbed-v1 (strict), wadeable non-canal frame. 66 of 175 stations of this ecoregion pass. 31 reference curves use local stations, 0 borrow from a wider region, 5 metrics use fixed criteria, and 0 metrics are withheld for insufficient reference support. 23 published curves are carried forward unchanged from version 8, and 2 were rebuilt because the data verification corrected values they rested on.
